source_documents.title: Homoconjugation-induced enhancements of photophysical properties in donor–acceptor triptycenes arise from interplay between intramolecular charge transfer and exciton states

reference_evidence_units.quote: We can therefore conclude that the S1 / S0 transition and the longest wavelength absorbance are of ICT character.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 0F-3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: Positive solvatochromism of the emission: S1 is an ICT state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: that nICT pertains to the singlet S1 / S0 transition from the donor ladder-region(s) into the acceptor phenazine(s).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 0F-3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: S1 is ladder-donor to phenazine-acceptor CT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The experimental and calculated values for MMID are in excellent agreement while those for MICT are not.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1F-3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: The mid-spectrum transition dipole scales with the square root of the number of fins, as an exciton model predicts; the ICT band does not.

reference_evidence_units.quote: suggests that exciton interactions are only occurring upon population of the higher excited states represented by nMID.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1F-3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: Exciton coupling between fins is confined to the higher (mid-spectrum) states.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Absorption-based; emission is from the ICT state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Examining the peak intensities, 3MID more than doubles moving from 1F
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1F vs 2F vs 3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: Mid-spectrum absorptivity grows 45 → 94 → 128 x 10^3 M-1 cm-1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Overall, these observations demonstrate generality to the exciton model proposed for a trefoil system, which agrees very well with the nMID region for 1F–3F.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1F-3F

reference_evidence_units.quote: most notably for the largest molecule 3F with a value of 86 ± 12% which is comparable with some of the most strongly emitting superradiant J-aggregates.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: Φf 66-86% across the series, highest for 3F.

reference_evidence_units.quote: effectively throttled by the kr of the ICT state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1F-3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission rate is set by the ICT kr (3-5 x 10^7 s-1), not by the exciton manifold; lifetimes lengthen from 1F to 3F.

reference_evidence_units.quote: is well-shielded from the external solution thereby circumventing intermolecular loss pathways.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3F
reference_evidence_units.statement: The trefoil core shields 3F from solvent, lowering knr.

reference_evidence_units.quote: are monoexponential, which is characteristic of triplet excitons on these timescales.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 0F-3F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: toluene, µs transient absorption, reversible O2 quenching
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Triplet yield not quantified; ps-TA blocked by emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Emission from the ladder-to-phenazine ICT state (solvatochromism, TDDFT).

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Long-lived triplet excitons by µs-TA with O2 quenching.

contrast_group.varied_factor: number of donor-acceptor fins on the triptycene (1, 2, 3)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Same ICT emission; mid-spectrum absorption grows by homoconjugation-mediated exciton coupling between fins; 3F is the brightest (Φf 86%).
